definition: a very hard, sparkling stone used in jewelry
description: A gloved jeweler holds a sparkling diamond in tweezers over a green velvet cushion while a red-haired customer gasps in amazement at how it catches the light. The jeweler inspects the stone through a loupe, then presents a finished diamond ring on the cushion and the woman covers her mouth in delight.
transcript: It's on fire! Hardest thing on earth.
